authorInfo.bio: Anthony Trollope (1815–1882) is the author of The Warden. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.

description: "Is He Popenjoy?" by Anthony Trollope is a novel written in the late 19th century. The story begins by introducing readers to the characters and setting, particularly focusing on Mary Lovelace and Lord George Germain, and the complications of their social standings and familial expectations.
